name: Purple Kush | Premier Cured Resin Cartridge | 1g
description: Rove's products are made using 100% organically grown cannabis, sourced directly from trusted farms in their collective network. Their premium C02 oil is passed through a completely solvent-less purification process, removing waxes, chlorophyll, and other unwanted plant materials. The golden finished product is then loaded into Rove's low-temp, hassle-free ceramic core cartridge for a truly special vaping experience.
